inputs.text:
Folks, look at what’s happening in Cyprus. On Monday, lawyers sounded the alarm over changes to their surveillance legislation, and frankly, it’s about time someone stood up for basic rule of law and proper safeguards. They are trying to strip away judicial oversight—the very thing that keeps overreaching authorities in check and protects traditional social order and personal privacy. 

This dangerous amended bill is barreling straight toward the House plenum for a vote this Thursday. And what is the opposition saying? According to Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides, this came right out of a recent closed session of the House. It’s always behind closed doors when the progressive establishment tries to dismantle accountability and erode the institutions that families and everyday citizens rely on for stability. We need transparency, order, and respect for proper legal traditions, not a rushed power grab that leaves people vulnerable.
